claims: The University of Hawaiʻi (UH) is a public higher education system.
The University of Hawaiʻi (UH) is co-educational.
The University of Hawaiʻi (UH) comprises 10 campuses across six islands in the state of Hawaiʻi.
The University of Hawaiʻi (UH) was established as a single campus in 1907.
The University of Hawaiʻi (UH) system includes three four-year universities.
The University of Hawaiʻi (UH) system includes seven community colleges.
The University of Hawaiʻi (UH) serves approximately 49,977 students.
The University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa is the flagship institution of the University of Hawaiʻi (UH).
The University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa is an R1 research university.
The University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa is one of only three institutions in the U.S. to hold land-, sea-, space-, and sun-grant designations.
The UH System offers over 200 degree programs.
The UH System offers degree programs ranging from short-term certificates and associate degrees to doctoral and professional degrees in law and medicine.
University of Hawaii at Manoa is located at 2500 Campus Rd.
University of Hawaii at Hilo is located in Hilo, HI.
University of Hawaiʻi – West Oʻahu is located in Kapolei, HI.
University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa has 17 schools and colleges.
University of Hawaii at Manoa was established in 1907.
University of Hawaii at Hilo was established in 1945.
University of Hawaiʻi – West Oʻahu was established in 1976.
University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa includes the Shidler College of Business.
University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa includes the School of Architecture.
University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa includes a school of Law.
University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa includes a school of Medicine.
UH Online offers over 40 degree and certificate programs across the system.
UH Mānoa has an acceptance rate around 70–87%.
Admitted students to UH Mānoa typically have a mid-range GPA of 3.49–4.04.
UH Mānoa considers SAT scores of 1130–1350.
UH Mānoa considers ACT scores of 21–29.
UH Mānoa follows a test-optional policy.
UH West Oʻahu requires a 2.7 cumulative high school GPA for automatic admission for freshmen.
Transfer students to UH Mānoa generally require at least 24 transferable credits with a minimum GPA of 2.5.
Transfer students to UH West Oʻahu generally require at least 24 transferable credits with a minimum GPA of 2.0.
University of Hawaiʻi – West Oʻahu has 43 academic concentrations.
Popular majors at UH Mānoa include Psychology, Marketing, Nursing, Finance, and Biology.
